headline: Profit surges as margins expand and AI stakes pay off
summary_short: Revenue rose 5.5% y/y to $1,239.0M as Enterprise growth and margin discipline lifted net income 67.2% to $425.7M, aided by $152.3M of gains on strategic AI investments including Anthropic.
summary_long: Revenue grew 5.5% y/y to $1,239.0M, driven by 7.2% Enterprise growth and 2.8% Online growth. Gross margin expanded 160bps to 77.9% on lower stock-based comp. S&M fell 4.9% and G&A fell 5.9%, even as R&D rose 11% on AI headcount; operating income rose 28.5% to $310.5M. Net income rose 67.2% to $425.7M, aided by $152.3M of gains on strategic AI investments (including Anthropic) vs a $13.6M loss a year ago. Free cash flow was $500.5M; board added a $1.0B buyback authorization (May 2026). Next-quarter guidance: $1.265-1.270B revenue, $1.45-1.47 non-GAAP EPS; full-year revenue guided to $5.080-5.090B.

Margin gain driven by lower stock-based compensation in cost of revenue plus other operational efficiencies.
